title.suggested: Tom Allen Talks of Returning to America

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Tom Allen, out of sight since his Kentucky fight with Joe Goss, wrote a St. Louis friend that he might return to America, and that a San Francisco sport's unknown was said to be Allen.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Sunday Morning, November 24, 1878, page 3; part of the 'Sporting Spice' column (see article 622, the same column's headline).

facts.fact: Allen wrote to a St. Louis friend that he was thinking of returning to America, having stayed out of sight since his fight with Joe Goss in Kentucky
Johnny Minan of San Francisco offered to match an unknown, said to be Allen, for $1,000 or $2,000 a side against Johnny Dwyer, Paddy Ryan or Mike McCoole

notes: The article does not say where Allen was writing from. Article 622 is the headline of the same column and likely a duplicate.
